production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same SEC financial-report text set, order/backlog demand evidence-span extractor, T+1 reaction gate, liquidity gate, overlap exclusion, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC order/backlog demand evidence-span rule did not clear Gate 4. The likely reason is that backlog, bookings, contract award, and RPO language is either sparse, already reflected in the T+1 reaction, too generic across earnings releases, or not incremental to accepted SEC RS20 support after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping backlog, bookings, contract-award, RPO, T+1, ADV/price, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs materially richer PIT semantic provenance, such as extracted backlog growth rate, book-to-bill magnitude, contract duration/funding certainty, named customer importance, or forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper.
